evidence: Resolves an attribute context, dispatches its +0xd8 callback when present, queries context status selectors 2 and 1, calls evaluate_attribute_context_compatibility, and invokes initialize_attribute_output_slots on the supplied object. Depending on the two status/compatibility results it updates indexed global entries and writes the 0xffffffff sentinel to record fields. No indexed caller is available. Source: decompiled/main/main_0081.c:41154-41219; accepted callee evidence at tools/data/function_annotations.tsv: for evaluate_attribute_context_compatibility and initialize_attribute_output_slots.

Branches on the supplied mode flag and two state bytes, resolves a loading-screen resource, performs runtime dispatch/initialization, then gates on context_status_ids_13_0_18_equal_4_8_2 and check_dynamic_loading_screens_enabled. On the enabled path it calls register_named_texture_pointer for the Texture key; otherwise it follows the alternate resource path. Source: decompiled/main/main_0172.c:18428-18504; helper behavior at tools/data/function_annotations.tsv for 0x7000f21138 and 0x7000470674.

Compares the supplied record value at +0xa0 with a value derived from a global property, queries attribute-context status selector 1, checks attribute_context_status_value_is_zero_for_id_20 and attribute_context_value_is_supported, and calls a helper that compares the record value against a context-derived limit. It then returns a small status code and may set a global byte when the record has a backing object. Exact domain meaning of the value remains unknown. Source: decompiled/main/main_0104.c:50389-50468; accepted helper evidence in tools/data/function_annotations.tsv for 0x700076c1e0 and 0x700185bc90.

Checks the accepted context predicate for status IDs 0x13/0/0x18 and additional status-19/property-0x13 predicates. When the context record is eligible, it obtains a callback from object+0x18 and runtime-dispatches it, then makes repeated helper calls with fixed selector IDs (0x1c, 0x238, 0x21f, 0x13f, 0x213, 0xac, 0x2bc). The individual update meanings are unresolved; this label stays at the visible dispatch/status behavior. No indexed caller is available. Source: decompiled/main/main_0172.c:16323-16396; accepted predicates at tools/data/function_annotations.tsv for 0x70000a8e90, 0x70000a8ef0, and 0x70000aab20.

Initializes/resolves a contextual record, validates its type marker, reads its code at +0x8, and derives an output byte from code-range tests plus attribute-context status predicates. The code is copied to the output for one supported range; other paths use context status 9 and helper predicates to select a status value. The code/domain mapping remains unresolved. No indexed caller is available. Source: decompiled/main/main_0058.c:47847-47938; accepted helper labels initialize_contextual_record, attribute_context_status_is_2_or_3, and get_context_status_9_if_valid.
